self-will.definition:
n resolute adherence to your own ideas or desires
n the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior

self-willed.definition: s habitually disposed to disobedience and opposition
self-willed.translation: a. 任性的, 顽固的

self-winding.definition: s. designed so that manual winding is unnecessary

self-worth.definition: n the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
